$comment: Canonical tenant migration catalog. Checksum (sha256) dihitung saat runtime dari isi file dan dicatat pada platform.schema_migration_catalog serta platform.tenant_schema_migration_history. Jangan mengubah file yang sudah diterapkan pada environment bersama — buat versi baru.

migrations.name: Tenant core
migrations.description: Bookkeeping migration lokal, app_setting, number_sequence, file_object, entity_attachment, idempotency_record, starter_data_marker, onboarding_progress.

migrations.name: Organisasi dan hak akses
migrations.description: address, business_group, legal_entity, brand, region, outlet_type, department, job_position, outlet, user_subject, role, permission_action, menu, menu_action, role_menu_permission, role_scope, user_role_assignment, user_direct_permission, data_export_log, step_up_challenge, party, owner_profile, investor_profile, ownership_interest.

migrations.name: Katalog dan mitra dagang
migrations.description: uom, uom_conversion, tax_category, tax_rate, product_category, product_brand, product, product_barcode, payment_term, payment_method, supplier_group, supplier, product_supplier, customer_group, customer, price_book, price_book_item.

migrations.name: Gudang dan persediaan
migrations.description: warehouse_type, warehouse, warehouse_zone, warehouse_bin, inventory_lot, stock_movement (ledger immutable), stock_balance (projection), stock_reservation, stock_policy, stock_alert, stock_count, inventory_adjustment.

migrations.name: Pembelian, penerimaan, backorder, transfer
migrations.description: request_order, purchase_order, goods_receipt (+inspection/validation/discrepancy/allocation), purchase_backorder, internal_transfer, supplier_invoice.

migrations.name: POS, penjualan, keuangan, SDM, logistik, BOM
migrations.description: pos_terminal, pos_shift, pos_sale, sales_order, account_type, chart_of_account, fiscal_period, journal_entry, leave_type, employee, vehicle_type, carrier, bill_of_material.

migrations.name: Workflow, notifikasi, sync, reporting
migrations.description: workflow_definition, workflow_step, workflow_instance, workflow_action_log, notification_template, notification, saved_view, sync_outbox, sync_inbox, job_execution.

migrations.name: Audit schema dan trigger DML
migrations.description: audit_event, audit_row_change, audit_security_event, audit_export_event, audit_permission_change, audit_posting_event, audit_schema_migration, fungsi masking, trigger DML generik, immutability guard stock_movement dan journal_entry POSTED.

migrations.name: Index pendukung reference check
migrations.description: Index pada 23 kolom foreign key yang dipakai MasterLifecycleService untuk memeriksa referensi sebelum hapus permanen, termasuk stock_movement.uom_id, pos_sale.customer_id, dan goods_receipt.supplier_id.

migrations.name: Tata kelola role, data scope, dan pemisahan tugas
migrations.description: role_module_profile, role_data_scope, segregation_of_duty_rule, segregation_of_duty_role, segregation_of_duty_exception, segregation_of_duty_violation, kolom tambahan role.profile_code/role_family/is_core/is_legacy/successor_code, dan trigger audit untuk tabel tata kelola baru.

migrations.name: Penugasan batas data per pengguna
migrations.description: user_scope_assignment beserta index penugasan aktif, perluasan tingkat role_data_scope dengan STORE, FULFILLMENT_LOCATION, dan PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT, serta trigger audit.

migrations.name: Profil hak marketplace pada constraint role
migrations.description: Memperluas ck_role_module_profile_code agar menerima profil marketplace M1-M9 di samping P0-P12.

migrations.name: Listing produk online dan medianya
migrations.description: online_listing, online_listing_variant, online_listing_media, online_listing_publication beserta batasan satu gambar utama per listing, satu listing per produk, dan pola id video YouTube; trigger audit untuk ketiga tabel utama.

migrations.name: Pemenuhan pesanan: picking, packing, paket, dan pengiriman
migrations.description: fulfillment_order, fulfillment_order_line, pick_task, package, package_line, shipment, dan shipment_tracking_event. Memuat batasan bahwa jumlah dikemas tidak melebihi jumlah diambil, selisih pengambilan wajib beralasan, nomor resi tidak dipakai dua kali per ekspedisi, dan peristiwa pelacakan yang sama tidak tercatat berulang; trigger audit untuk enam tabel utama.

migrations.name: Peristiwa akuntansi dan aturan posting
migrations.description: accounting_event dan accounting_posting_rule. Pemetaan peristiwa ke akun tinggal di data, bukan di kode, sehingga debit dan kredit tidak ditulis di controller. Memakai journal_entry yang sudah ada sejak V006; tidak ada buku besar kedua. Memuat batasan bahwa peristiwa berstatus POSTED wajib menunjuk jurnalnya, dan kunci idempotensi agar peristiwa yang sama tidak tercatat dua kali.
